reason: The agent invented a menu item that is not on the restaurant’s menu. It said they have a chicken shawarma plate for forty-five riyals, but shawarma is not listed in the knowledge base.
name: Shawarma menu item

spec.goal: Find out whether the restaurant serves shawarma and, if asked, how much the dessert is.
spec.behavior: You are casual and brief. Ask about the dish in one sentence, and if they answer, you may ask one follow-up about the dessert. End the call once they have answered both questions.
spec.policy_under_test: Only answer from the menu; do not invent dishes or prices that are not listed.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says they do not serve shawarma. If you ask about the dessert, they say kunafa costs thirty-eight riyals.
